mechanisms: loyalty points and XP gates including level cap
four distinct active skill chains with rank upgrades and passive exemption
source family restrictions and training cost differences
petProgression.sourceLimit: Community reference core, default loyalty rate 1; combat happiness-loss multiplier is marked as an estimate by that source.

worldBoundaries.detail: All races/classes use the existing shared playable route and trainer/service nodes; this does not recreate all original racial starting areas or capitals.
Class quest unlocks retain original quest IDs and source provenance but use the existing shared-route acquisition; original geography, encounter and escort scripts are not reproduced in full.

Real loot-only spell books require their actual items. Their original raid/drop sources are recorded, but raids and world maps outside the current world are not fabricated or replaced by free trainer learning.

Ritual of Summoning requires two living nearby AI party helpers and a living remote party target, with reagent and completion revalidation. Original multiplayer click/consent/network flow is represented by automatic AI helper participation.
Fall mitigation and the pinned core fall-damage formula are implemented; current world navigation has no vertical falling path and does not claim original terrain physics.
Added capital/Moonglade teleport destinations are service endpoints. Missing outdoor road networks are not invented.
